messages:
morgan: hey, quick help — customer hit a 500. I have trace id 8c1e9d4f7a. Console shows spans but clicking doesn't surface the raw request lines. where do I grab the full req log (headers + body) for that trace? cc @devon

devon: short answer: try the edge-proxy logs first (look for the X-Request-Ref or the trace token) -> then the backend pod logs. if the trace span has a k8s.pod attribute copy that and use stern/grep.

morgan: console span only shows span_id and `x-rw-trace:8c1e9d4f` not the req header. any quick command?

tara: stern is usually fastest. example:
```bash
stern edge-proxy -n prod --container proxy --since 30m | rg '8c1e9d4f'
```
if that returns nothing, run:
```bash
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=edge-proxy -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl logs -n prod {} -c proxy --since=1h | rg '8c1e9d4f'
```

devon: if proxy obfuscates body, try the backend pod that handled the request (span UI usually shows "k8s.pod" or "service.name"). also check the cache layer — prefix cache can return a cached response without touching the backend, so there might be no backend logs.

morgan: got a hit in edge-proxy but the line is kind of json-in-a-single-line. how do I pretty print to find headers?

tara: pipe to jq or python; e.g.:
```bash
... | rg '8c1e9d4f' | jq -R 'fromjson? // .'
```
or if the payload is embedded in other text, grab a window around the match:
```bash
... | rg '8c1e9d4f' -n | sed -n '1,40p' | jq .
```

ops-bot: FYI alert: #observability/500s spike for service=redwood-api, 12 occurrences in last 5m :rotating_light:

morgan: ty! one more Q: if trace -> pod mapping is missing in the span UI, any quick fallback?

devon: check the internal request-ref service/cli. it maps trace tokens -> request id -> pod/timestamp. example CLI:
```bash
request-ref lookup 8c1e9d4f7a
```
it prints the pod and approximate timestamp. you can also hit the request-ref service in the console (Tools -> Request Ref). @request-ref-bot can return a fast lookup if you call `/lookup 8c1e9d4f7a` here.

request-ref-bot: lookup result for 8c1e9d4f7a: pod=api-worker-57b8, node=n1-prod-043, timestamp=2026-02-14T21:12:03Z

morgan: awesome. grabbing logs now and will post any suspicious headers/bodies I find. :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup: if you need a hand with regex or extracting multi-line bodies ping me and I can jump in.
